arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Edwin Kneedler argued the Constitution does not grant citizenship to those born abroad.
He stated Congress determines which categories receive citizenship by statute.
Justice Kagan questioned if the statute violates equal protection.
She asked if Congress could have written the law differently to avoid gender bias.
